description: Repurpose content into platform-specific formats. Takes a blog post, transcript, or article and generates optimized versions for Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Substack, email, and video. Requires a CONTENT_REPURPOSER_API_KEY.

content.description: The source content to repurpose (blog post, transcript, etc.). Minimum 50 characters.

formats.description: Output formats to generate. Options: twitter_thread, linkedin_post, substack_notes, email_snippet, video_script. Defaults to all 5.

source_type.description: Type of source content: blog_post, youtube_transcript, or podcast_transcript

source_url.description: Optional URL of the original content for attribution

name: repurpose_content
